<h2 class="section-title">India Markets</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Market Correction:</strong> Indian indices have hit one-year lows, wiping out significant market capitalization as investors grapple with the impact of the US-Israel-Iran conflict and persistent FPI outflows totaling ₹52,100 crore in October.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I5</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Policy and Macro Outlook:</strong> The RBI is shifting toward a hawkish stance to combat inflation and currency depreciation, while investors remain focused on upcoming Q2 earnings, MPC minutes, and the Jio Platforms IPO to gauge market direction.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I4</a></span></li>
</ul>
